races.title: Coral 'Black Friday Price Boosts' 'National Hunt' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict: PRINCE RUPERT looked something out of the ordinary when making a winning bumper debut at Kempton back in March, a race Nicky Henderson landed with Shishkin a few years earlier. He's an exciting prospect now hurdling with his yard boasting a fine record in this race. Unsurprisingly there is depth in opposition, with dangers headed up by fellow impressive bumper winner River Kwai . Ffos Las second Oatsoeasy and Lover Desbois complete the shortlist. PRINCE RUPERT RIVER KWAI (FR) OATSOEASY (IRE)

races.title: Play Coral 'Racing-Super-Series' For Free 'National Hunt' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict: STICK TO THE BOARD failed to land the odds on his Chepstow hurdling debut but was still a promising first effort in this sphere in a race that's worked out well, and he's taken to go one better with the return to 2m unlikely to inconvenience him. Octo Gane and useful bumper performer Tally Ho Back head the dangers. STICK TO THE BOARD (IRE) OCTO GANE (FR) TALLY HO BACK

races.title: Coral Racing Club Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: Preference is for KLUB DE REVE who progressed with each of his 4 starts over hurdles last season, landing a Grade 2 novice at Kempton with a bit in hand on his final outing. He could be capable of even better as a chaser and is fancied to make a successful handicap debut, though Country Mile isn't taken lightly with the form of his Uttoxeter win working out well. KLUB DE REVE (FR) COUNTRY MILE (IRE) MASKED MAN (FR)
races.bettingForecast: Klub De Reve (6/4), Country Mile (3/1), Hardly Surprising (10/3), Masked Man (4/1)

races.title: Coral 'Daily Rewards Shaker' Fillies' Juvenile Hurdle (Listed) (GBB Race)
races.verdict: KOALA ROSE made an impressive start over hurdles with an emphatic success at Hereford, jumping accurately in the main, and she can take this step up in grade in her stride for her leading yard. She gets the vote ahead of Nathalie Jolie who was successful on her only start in France, while Irish raider Espritroyale could also be in the mix. KOALA ROSE (IRE) NATHALIE JOLIE ESPRITROYALE (IRE)

races.title: Coral John Francome Novices' Chase (Grade 2) (GBB Race)
races.verdict: TAURUS BAY looks likely to take high rank amongst this season's novice chasers on the evidence of his impressive win in the Rising Stars and he can defy a penalty to take his record to 2-2 in this sphere. Tutti Quanti had a very good record here over hurdles and looks the biggest danger, with Royal Infantry also respected having jumped fluently to win a pair of 3-runner races. TAURUS BAY (IRE) TUTTI QUANTI (FR) ROYAL INFANTRY (IRE)
races.bettingForecast: Taurus Bay (13/8), Royal Infantry (5/2), Tutti Quanti (11/4), Favour And Fortune (8/1), Catchintsavo (16/1)

races.title: Coral 'Bet10 Get50 Sign Up Offer' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: Cases can be made for a few but ETALON has been in better heart than recent form figures would suggest, far from discredited when a never-nearer fourth at Aintree 3 weeks ago. Back down to his last winning mark with cheekpieces refitted, he could be ready to strike, with confidence behind him in the market likely to bolster that view. Exeter scorer Kap Ouest is easily one of the least exposed and feared on return, with last year's winner Twinjets another expected to play a lead role. ETALON (IRE) KAP OUEST (FR) TWINJETS (IRE)

races.title: Coral Long Distance Hurdle (Grade 2) (GBB Race)
races.verdict: The unbeaten LE FRIMEUR produced a taking display when scoring in Grade 1 company at the Punchestown festival and he might be able to improve beyond some of the more established names in this division, chiefly last season's winner Impose Toi , who also merits consideration given his exemplary record fresh. Ma Shantou is better than he showed at the Cheltenham Festival and would also be foolish to dismiss. LE FRIMEUR (FR) IMPOSE TOI (FR) MA SHANTOU (IRE)

races.title: Coral 'Pipped-At-The-Post' And Win Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: Winner of a point and his hurdling debut, WESTERN MONKEY shaped well after 11 months off when finishing mid-field over this C&D 22 days ago and he can build on his reappearance effort to resume winning ways. Heading the list of dangers is Harbour Light as he bids for a 5-timer, while Lihyan is another to consider from a handy mark. WESTERN MONKEY HARBOUR LIGHT LIHYAN (IRE)
